book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Bo ka munaŋ a Jiso jiŋ
Jiso jɛmɛ mwɛɛ munɛ munchii wu mɛsɛ, wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kêe lɛ shɛge wa aju afaa, mo nyume Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe, ba lé ba nyâ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh chiaaŋ yi bamii le ba ta wu yi kintaaŋ le.”

content: Gɛh kife kiyu le, bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ mo bo gɛɛŋ bo banyɛ ye a nto wu Kayfa wù gɛ̀ bee kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ le,
bo chu ntaŋ no bo lé bo gê bo wɛɛnɛ fɛ bo koo Jiso, bo yuuyɛ.
Bo doo bo chude ntaŋ noo, bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Keefɛ bee moŋ fiɛɛ finɛ kife ki Ŋka wunɛ le gɛ, nje bee moŋ lo, fi to bɛ jwe a bamii ntɛnɛɛ.”
Kwɛse wumu yefɛ Jiso bɛ mɛɛ mà gwee wuŋ Bɛtani
Jiso gɛ̀ bee ntɛ wù Bɛtani le, a Samoŋ yeh wù gɛ̀ bee muh goŋ yì baaŋ.
Bo shii bo jii mwɛɛ, kwɛse wumu ja wu lee bɛ fikaaŋ fimi ba kɛnyi bɛ tɛdɛ
nyu fi mɛɛ mamu mà gwee wuŋ, mò tɛɛme kwa baaŋ, wu mo wu fuushɛ yi kikwɛɛ ki Jiso le.
Booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo yɛŋ noo fiɛɛ fiyu toonyɛ lo bo. Bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Wu chɛŋe bɛ mɛɛ mayu nɛ nje la?
Bee taŋlo ba gesɛ mɛɛ manɛ yi bige le wesee, ba nya bige biyu bamii ba fuude le.”
Geenɛ, Jiso kɛɛ ŋkwajɛ wuboo, wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ nyaa ŋgɛ kwɛse wunɛ le nɛ nje la? Wu le wu ge nyu fiɛɛ fì joŋe fɛ mɛne.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ bamii ba fuude lé bo gê bo nyu bena bo segechii, geenɛ gɛ mɛ nyu ŋge nyume bɛ bɛŋ segechii gɛ.
Wu fuushi mɛɛ manɛ ye yaŋ le nɛ wu seese nyu njiiyɛ waŋ.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ mo nyu faaŋ fɛ ba lé ba gê ba feeji saaka wù joŋe wunɛ yi kikwɛɛ ki nshɛŋ le kichii fiɛɛ fì kwɛse wunɛ ge ba lé ba sɛ̂ŋe tɛ ki ba kwaji wu.”

content: Juda gesɛ Jiso
Muh mu ŋgoo yi booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ le, wù ba gɛ̀ tɛŋe lɛ Juda Ɛkaliot mo wu ja wu gɛɛŋ fɛ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ le,
wu biih bo le lɛ, “Mɛ nɛ nyâ Jiso chiaaŋ yene le, bɛŋ nyâ mɛ la?” Bo mo bo taŋ bige mbanshɛ bì ba kɛnyi bɛ kichwa kì baaŋ, bo nya wu le.
Kɛge sege kɛɛ le, wu mo wu kɛ wu goone je yì wu lé wu nyâ Jiso chiaaŋ yiboo le.
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ji Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe

Lɛ doo nyume juu chi fwe chi Ŋka wu Blɛd wù ba baaŋ gɛɛ gɛ Kinshilɛ yo gɛ, booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso to fɛ wu le, bo biih wu le lɛ, “Wo goone lɛ bee gɛɛŋ be seesɛ fɛ wo lé wo jî Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe fo nyu faaŋ?”
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ gɛ̂ɛŋ alaantɛŋ, bɛŋ lé bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ muh mu le, bɛŋ du wu le lɛ, ‘Muh wu N'yɛyɛ duu lɛ kife ke le ki kojɛ ka. Wu lé wu ji Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo nyu a wo yeh.’”

content: Booŋ ba ŋgoo bayu gɛɛŋ bo ge gɛh no Jiso be jɛmɛ bo le, bo mo bo seesɛ mwɛɛ munjile mu Ŋka wu Ndaŋfe wuyu fo.
Lɛ to nyume fɛnfu, wu shii bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ ki bo jii.
Lɛ bo doo bo jii mwɛɛ, wu ja wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, muh mu bɛŋ le, lé wu gê wu gêsɛ mɛ.”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, booŋ be ba ŋgoo tu bo nyume yii yii, bo kɛ bo biide wu le wu mumwaa wu mumwaa lɛ, “Le mɛ Tada?”
Wu chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù lé wu gêsɛ mɛ le wù leesɛ kibo a shu le besa wu.
Muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé wu gɛ̂ɛŋ gɛh no ba gɛ̀ saŋ kune wu. Geenɛ, ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le fɛ muh wu le wu gesɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh le. Fi be joŋe fɛ wuwɛɛ muh le lɛ keefɛ ba bôo wu gɛ.”

content: Juda wù gɛ̀ bee ki wu gêsɛ Jiso biih tɛ wu le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ le mɛ?” Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo le wo jɛmɛ bɛ jwe wo.”

content: Jiso bɛ booŋ be ji ntɛ
No bo jii mwɛɛ, Jiso ja wu jo blɛd, wu nya kiyone Nyo le, wu bweeyɛ wu nya booŋ be ba ŋgoo le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ ko bɛŋ ji, finɛ le ye yaŋ.”

content: Wu ka wu jo tɛ fiŋkoo, wu nya kiyone Nyo le wu mo wu nya fiŋkoo fiyu bo le wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ mu bɛŋ bachii.
Finɛ le kilɛmɛ kaŋ kì Nyo le wu gwo maŋkaŋ yu ki bu nje bamii ba duude, wu lɛ wu lé wu lɛ̂ɛshɛ bimbefɛ biboo.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ gɛ mbaaŋ ŋka mu mbvuuŋ ma nchwɛŋ wu kite kì laane manɛ gɛ, kɛge mɛɛse gɛɛne bude juu chì nlé ŋgê mû manfɛŋ besabɛŋ antɛnɛɛ a bvunfoŋ bvu Chii gɛ.”

content: Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ mɛsɛ, bo yɛɛŋ ŋkee wu mbɛɛŋsɛ, bo mo bo bu bo bɛɛŋ bo gɛɛŋ yi Mbegɛ wu Bite bi Olif le.
Jiso jɛmɛ lɛ Bita lé wu gê wu faŋ wu
No Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ gɛɛne, wu ja wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Kintaŋ ki abɛŋ kinɛ le bɛŋ bachii lé bɛŋ gê bɛŋ chii bikaa a mɛ jiŋ nje fiɛɛ fì lé fi gê fi kooshɛ bɛ mɛ. Le no ba le ba saŋ lɛ Nyo duu lɛ, ‘Nlé ŋgê n'yûuyɛ nchiɛnɛ shóŋ, ŋgoo yi shóŋ saaŋɛ.’
Geenɛ, sege Nyo bvusɛ mɛ yi kwe le, nsa bɛŋ fwe Galalee.”

content: Bita mo wu jɛmɛ lo fie wu le lɛ, “Nɛ bamii bachii nɛ chile lo bikaa a wo jiŋ nje fiɛɛ fì lé fi gê fi kooshɛ bɛ wo, tu gɛ taŋlo n'yu nto nchii bikaa a wo jiŋ gɛ.”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe wo nchiɛɛŋ lɛ kintaŋ ki abɛŋ kinɛ le, nyishii lé yi gê yi toŋ, wo nyu wo faŋ wa mɛ kiŋgane kintɛde.”

content: Bita jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Mo fi nyume lɛ nlé ŋkwê lo besa wo, tu gɛ taŋlo n'yu nfaŋ wo gɛ.” No wu jɛmɛ noo, booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso bamu baa bachii jɛmɛ gɛh tɛ noo.
Jiso buunɛ Gɛsɛmani
Jiso bɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo gɛ̀ gɛɛŋ bo lee Gɛsɛmani fɛ mwɛ wu muntaŋ wumu le, Jiso jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ shii fɛnɛ ŋkɛŋsɛ fege mbuunɛ.”

content: Wu jo Bita bɛ booŋ ba Jɛbɛdi ba bafɛɛ, bɛ bo gɛɛŋ. Wu kɛ wu tu wù nyu yii yii, fitele fie fuuŋse wu.
Wu mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Fitele fiaŋ le yii yii baaŋ njɛ ŋkwe lo. Bɛŋ shɛ̂ɛ fɛnɛ bɛŋ chîɛɛne!”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu kɛŋsɛ wu gɛɛŋ fwe shige, wu gwe wu tuŋ bvushi fɛkuu wu mo wu buunɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Chii, nɛ je bee yu yì taŋlo wo ge fiŋkoo fi ŋgɛ finɛ fe lɛ keefɛ mɛ mu gɛ, wo ge. Geenɛ, keefɛ wo gê no ŋgoone gɛ, gêe no wo goone.”

content: Wu gɛ̀ ja wu kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ fɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le, wu yɛŋ bo lefe. Wu biih Bita le lɛ,

content.text: “Fi le lɛ gɛ taŋlo bɛŋ shii bɛ mɛ we gɛɛŋ bu ntaŋ wu kife wu mumwaa gɛ?
Bɛŋ nyûme we, bɛŋ bûune lɛ keefɛ moŋ ge wu to fɛ bɛŋ le gɛ. Le nchiɛɛŋ lɛ fitele koŋe lo, geenɛ nyaŋ yi ye wɛɛyi.”

content: Wu ka wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛŋ kiŋgane kinfɛɛ wu buunɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Chii, nɛ fi le lɛ gɛ fiŋkoo finɛ taŋlo fi fe lɛ keefɛ mɛ mu gɛ, wo ge gɛh no wo koŋe.”

content: Wu doo wu kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ wu ka wu yɛŋ booŋ be ba ŋgoo lefe nje lefɛ gɛ̀ bee bo ajii baaŋ.
Wu ka wu chinɛ bo le, wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛŋ wu ka wu buunɛ kiŋgane kintɛde, wu buune wu jɛme gɛh nyu fiɛɛ fì wu be jɛmɛ wa.
Wu ka wu kaasɛ wu tu jiŋ fɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ baaŋ gɛh bɛŋ lefe bɛŋ fufe shɛŋ? Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, kife le ki kojɛ ka. Ba lé ba gêsɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh bamii ba befe le.
Bɛŋ jâ we besabɛŋ gɛ̂ɛne. Bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ, nɛ muh wù gesɛ mɛ wunɛ wu too wa.”

content: Bo koo Jiso

Gɛh no Jiso gɛ̀ baaŋ wu jɛme noo, Juda wù gɛ̀ bee muh wu ŋgoo yi booŋ ba Jiso ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ mo wu bu. Wu gɛ̀ too bɛ kinchvu ki bamii kì baaŋ, bo kɛme nyó bɛ bimbuge, gɛ̀ tuŋ bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ mo bamii ba sage woŋ.
Gɛ̀ bee muh wù gɛ̀ gesɛ Jiso wu seesɛ wa njiŋɛ bɛ bamii bayu, wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Muh wù nlé ŋgê, ŋkfugɛ nshiŋɛ, tu le wu, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ koo.”
No bɛ bo to, wu mo wu gɛɛŋ lo fɛ Jiso le kimimia wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “N'yɛɛse wo le Muh wu N'yɛyɛ.” No wu jɛmɛ noo, wu mo wu kfugɛ wu wu shiŋɛ.
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsaa yaŋ, gee lo fiɛɛ fì wo to ki wo gê.”

content: Bamii baa mo bo gɛɛŋ lo fɛ Jiso le bo koo wu, bo fajɛ.
Fi kooshɛ lɛ muh mu wù gɛ̀ bee bɛ Jiso wu mo wu bvusɛ nyo yi jɛŋ, wu chuŋ kintuŋ ki nfwa wu kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ yu, ki suunɛ.
Jiso jɛmɛ muh wuyu le lɛ,

content.text: “Kaasɛ chvuu nyo yo fɛ kijusɛ ke le. Wo kêe lɛ muh wuchii wù chiaase nyo we, lé wu gê, wu kwe yi nyo le.
Wo kwaji lɛ gɛ taŋlo ndu Chii chiiŋsɛ banchɛndaa be fɛnɛ kimimia banchvuge le, bo fede ŋgoo yuufe ncho yifiɛɛ gɛ?
Geenɛ, nja ŋge noo, fi ge fi jiɛnyɛ nɛɛ fɛ fi kooshɛ no ba gɛ̀ saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le, no fi kɛme ki fi nyume?”

content: Sege kɛɛ, Jiso mo wu biih kinchvu kɛɛ le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ to ki bɛŋ kôo mɛ, bɛŋ tu too nyu bɛ nyó yi jɛŋ mo bimbuge njɛ bɛŋ too ki bɛŋ kôo nyume muh wu too bɛ ŋgɛ woŋ le? Nchi nshee lɛ juu lɛ juu nshiide yeh yi kintanyɛ le n'yɛyi bamii fo, fɛ bɛŋ koo mɛ sɛŋ, nje la?
Geenɛ, finɛ fichii jo kijusɛ ki fi to fi kojɛ no bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ saŋ.”

content: Booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo bachii mo bo noŋ wu fo, bo fɛɛ lo.
Jiso lɛɛŋ yeh yi nsa le
Bamii ba gɛ̀ kolɛ Jiso mo bo jo wu bo gɛɛŋ bɛ wu fɛ Kayfa wù gɛ̀ bee chiji kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ. Bamii ba duunyi banchi ba Nyo bɛ bamii ba sage woŋ gɛ̀ taashɛ wa fo.

Bo gɛ̀ gɛɛne bɛ Jiso, Bita bii lo ajiŋ je yì ndefe le. Wu gɛɛŋ wu bu fɛ lakfulɛ chi kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ le, wu lee wu gɛɛŋ wu shii bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ chiɛɛne la chiyu ki wu yɛ̂ŋ no fi lé fi gê fi jiɛnyɛ fi lɛɛŋ.
Bachiji kintanyɛ ba baaŋ baaŋ bɛ bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ sage bansa tu bo goone mwɛɛ mu chimbiaŋ mù bo kooyi yi Jiso le mù lé no mû ge ba yuuyɛ lo wu.
Geenɛ, bo gɛ̀ baaŋ kɛme gɛ fiɛɛ gɛ, mo no bamii ba duude gɛ̀ too fwe bo bɛɛyi jiŋ yi nsa wu chimbiaŋ. Fi gɛ̀ jiɛnyɛ nɛ, bamii bamu bafɛɛ to bo lɛɛŋ fwe,
bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Fimbwɛ finɛ chi fi du lɛ fi taŋlo fi sa yeh yi kintanyɛ yi Nyo fi kaasɛ fi jooŋ yi aju le atade.”
Kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ mo ki ja we ki biih Jiso le lɛ, “Gɛ wo kɛme fiɛɛ fì wo chvuu gɛ? Wo yuge gɛ̀ mwɛɛ mù bamii banɛ kooyi ye yo le?”
Jiso mɛ gɛh jwe wu chile. Kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ kaasɛ ki jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “A jee chi Nyo wù kɛme kinche le, nɛ wo fɛnɛ le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka wu le Mwa Nyo, wo sɛɛŋ bee le.”
Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Fi le no wo jɛme. Geenɛ nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ, ajiŋ a kife kinɛ bɛŋ lé bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh, wu shii a kibo kinchiɛɛŋ ki Muh wù kɛme Bvuŋga, bɛŋ ka bɛŋ yɛŋ no wu too yi kimbɛ le fɛwe”

content: Kikwɛɛ ki bachiji kintanyɛ yu noo, wu mo wu saayɛ njú ye, wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Wu jode kijusɛ ki Nyo. Bee ka goone muh lɛ wu lɛɛŋ fɛnɛ wu jɛmɛ lɛ la? Bɛŋ le bɛŋ yu wa no wu jode kijusɛ ki Nyo.
Bɛŋ le bɛŋ suunɛ lɛ la?” Bo chvuu lɛ, “Le muh wù ba yuuyɛ lo.”
Bo mo bo kɛ bo chuuyi nchwene yi bvushi bvu Jiso le, bo kfuunyi wu bɛ muŋko, bo suŋe wu bɛ chiaaŋ bo duu wu le lɛ,
“Wo le Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka, gɛh gêe la muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo kuŋ bee le mɛɛse. Gɛh sɛ̂ɛŋ muh wù suŋ wo.”
Bita faŋ Jiso
Gɛ̀ bee Bita shii akfuuŋ fɛ lakfulɛ. Mwa wù kwɛse wumu wù gɛ̀ lɛne fɛ la chiyu le, ja wu to mbebe ye le wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Wo tɛ be bee bena Jiso wu Galalee wege.”
Geenɛ, Bita faŋ a bamii bachii fwe wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛ ŋkee fiɛɛ fì wo jɛme gɛ.”
Bita mo wu ja wu bu wu gɛɛŋ wu tu wù nyu jwe wu kitaŋ le. Mwa wù kwɛse wumu wù gɛ̀ lɛne tɛ fo, wu yɛŋ wu le, wu mo wu jɛmɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ lɛme fo le lɛ, “Muh wunɛ bee bɛ Jiso wu Nasalɛ.”
Bita ka wu faŋ, wu lejɛ lo wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛ ŋkee muh wuyu gɛ.”
Lɛ kife kɛŋsɛ shige, bamii ba gɛ̀ lɛme fo kɛŋsɛ bo gɛɛŋ mbebe Bita le bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Yi nchiɛɛŋ le, wo le tɛ muh mu bo le, nje njɛmɛ wo gɛɛne njɛ wuboo.”
Bita mo wu kaŋ, wu tɛɛŋ loŋ yi kikwɛɛ ke le wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Gɛ ŋkee muh wunɛ gɛ.” Kimimia nyishii mo yi toŋ.
Bita kwajɛ njɛme wù Jiso be jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nyishii lé yi gê yi toŋ, wo nyu wo faŋ wa mɛ kiŋgane kintɛde.” Wu ja fo wu bu akfuuŋ, wu bee kwe baaŋ.

footnotes.text: Fikaaŋ finɛ le ba gɛ̀ kɛnyi bɛ tɛdɛ chi ba tɛŋe lɛ, “alabasta”.
Kɛnɛ le, “Nsaa yaŋ, wo ge fì wo bee ki ge la.”
